page_title: VER 0-2 ROM | Verona v AS Roma 24/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' 0 - 2 Goal! Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Paulo Dybala. The score is 0:2.
90+2' Robinio Vaz (AS Roma) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Simone Sozza who sees an offensive foul.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
88' Robinio Vaz (AS Roma) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
86' Paolo Sammarco prepares a substitution. Rafik Belghali is replaced by Ioan Vermesan (Verona).
84' The referee signals a substitution. Robinio Vaz (AS Roma) is brought on as a substitute for Donyell Malen.
84' Amin Sarr (Verona) fails to trouble the keeper from distance as his shot goes well wide of the right post.
82' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
80' Verona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
79' Verona have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
79' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted. Verona force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
78' The resulting set piece from Verona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag and Verona will take a corner.
77' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
77' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
73' Substitution. Manu Kone (AS Roma) has come on for Jan Ziolkowski.
72' A substitution has been made. Matias Soule is replaced by Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma).
71' Jan Ziolkowski (AS Roma) has tested the patience of referee Simone Sozza and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
70' Paolo Sammarco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) replacing Martin Frese.
70' Substitution. Amin Sarr (Verona) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Abdou Harroui walks off.

69' AS Roma slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
66' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Lorenzo Montipo makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner.
62' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post.
61' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

60' Matias Soule (AS Roma) takes a good first touch from a cross and fires a powerful low shot from the edge of the box towards the left post. The goalkeeper, though, is ready and denies him with a brilliant save. The ball is out of play and AS Roma manage to earn a corner.
58' Paolo Sammarco has decided to make a change. Al Musrati (Verona) replaces Sandi Lovric.
58' The substitution is prepared. Armel Bella-Kotchap (Verona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Tomas Suslov.
56' 0 - 1 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Paulo Dybala finds Donyell Malen (AS Roma) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:1.

56' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the right post. His effort isn't powerful enough, allowing Lorenzo Montipo to dive and keep the ball out with an excellent save.
56' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
55' The AS Roma players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

54' Play continues despite the shouts by some AS Roma players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Simone Sozza interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
53' Kieron Bowie (Verona) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
52' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

52' Matias Soule (AS Roma) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the top right corner, but Lorenzo Montipo easily deals with the threat. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for AS Roma.

52' A free kick is awarded from a very dangerous distance. It's situated just a few metres from outside the box. Several players gather around the ball, but it seems like Matias Soule (AS Roma) is going to have a crack himself.
50' RED CARD! Nicolas Valentini (Verona) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Simone Sozza. He can have an early bath.
49' A terrific attempt by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) from the edge of the box slides just narrowly past the right post.
49' The sound of the whistle has almost been drowned out in the deafening atmosphere of this match. Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is setting the ball up for a free kick from mid-range.
46' Gian Piero Gasperini has made a change at the break. Jan Ziolkowski (AS Roma) has come on in place of Daniele Ghilardi.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) is replaced by Neil El Aynaoui.
46' Referee Simone Sozza blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Simone Sozza shows a yellow card to Sandi Lovric (Verona), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) latched on to a lofted pass inside the box, but his header misses to the right of the target.
41' Rafik Belghali (Verona) sends a long ball in, but Mile Svilar comfortably gathers the ball.
41' Verona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

40' Kieron Bowie (Verona) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Mile Svilar makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best! The ball goes behind for a corner. Verona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
40' Chance! Tomas Suslov (Verona) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards goal, but Mile Svilar is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
35' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
33' Daniele Ghilardi (AS Roma) squandered a huge opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He blazed it high over the bar.
33' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

33' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Paulo Dybala (AS Roma), whose good effort would probably have ended inside the top right corner of the net. AS Roma force their opponents to concede a corner.
32' Simone Sozza blows his whistle. Sandi Lovric (Verona) commits a foul after dangerous play. AS Roma win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
30' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
30' The resulting corner, taken by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma), comes to nothing.
28' Tomas Suslov (Verona) takes the corner kick, but Mile Svilar reads it well and stops the effort.
28' Kieron Bowie (Verona) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Verona win a corner.
26' The corner kick from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
26' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. AS Roma force a corner. They send men into the box.
13' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post.
11' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
11' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
8' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
7' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman makes the right call and AS Roma will have a corner.
7' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Sandi Lovric (Verona). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
6' Abdou Harroui (Verona) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked. Verona will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
5' Kieron Bowie (Verona) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
1' Wonder save! Kieron Bowie (Verona) picked up the ball and hit a beautiful curling shot from the edge of the box. Mile Svilar saw it late but somehow got his fingers to the ball to keep it out.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and AS Roma will have the kick-off.
